startingCard.title: Elizabeth II becomes queen of the United Kingdom
startingCard.fact: Elizabeth II was Queen of the United Kingdom and other Commonwealth realms from 6 February 1952 until her death in 2022.

cards.title: Ariel Sharon becomes prime minister of Israel
cards.fact: Ariel "Arik" Sharon was an Israeli general and politician who served as the prime minister of Israel from March 2001 until April 2006.

cards.title: ‘Altered Beast’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game
cards.fact: Altered Beast is a 1988 beat 'em up video game developed by Team Shinobi and published by Sega for arcades.

cards.title: ‘Morrison Hotel’ is released
cards.subtitle: Album by The Doors
cards.fact: Morrison Hotel is the fifth studio album by American rock band the Doors, released on February 9, 1970, by Elektra Records.

cards.title: Afonso VI of Portugal becomes King of Portugal
cards.fact: Dom Afonso VI, known as "the Victorious", was the second king of Portugal of the House of Braganza from 1656 until his death.

cards.title: ‘Dragon's Dogma’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by Capcom
cards.fact: Dragon's Dogma is a 2012 action role-playing game developed and published by Capcom.

cards.title: Jaroslav Heyrovský dies
cards.subtitle: Czech chemist
cards.fact: Jaroslav Heyrovský was a Czech chemist and inventor who received the Nobel Prize in Chemistry in 1959 for his invention of polarography.

cards.title: Robert Peary dies
cards.subtitle: Explorer from the United States
cards.fact: Robert Edwin Peary was an American explorer and officer in the United States Navy who made several expeditions to the Arctic in the late 19th and early 20th centuries.

cards.title: ‘The Big Short’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by Adam McKay
cards.fact: The Big Short is a 2015 American biographical comedy drama film directed by Adam McKay from a screenplay by McKay and Charles Randolph.

cards.title: Pulcheria becomes Byzantine empress
cards.fact: Aelia Pulcheria was an Eastern Roman empress who advised her brother, the emperor Theodosius II, during his minority and then became wife to emperor Marcian from November 450 to her death in 453.

cards.title: Anthony Albanese becomes prime minister of Australia
cards.fact: Anthony Norman Albanese is an Australian politician who has served as the 31st prime minister of Australia since 2022.

cards.title: Panthéon is completed
cards.subtitle: Mausoleum in Paris for the most distinguished French people
cards.fact: The Panthéon is a monument in the 5th arrondissement of Paris, France.

cards.title: Best Buy is founded
cards.subtitle: American multinational consumer electronics retailer
cards.fact: Best Buy Co., Inc. is an American multinational consumer electronics retailer headquartered in Richfield, Minnesota.

cards.title: Fortezza of Rethymno is completed
cards.subtitle: Fortress in Crete
cards.fact: The Fortezza is the citadel of the city of Rethymno in Crete, Greece.

cards.title: John, King of England becomes king of England
cards.fact: John was King of England from 1199 until his death in 1216.

cards.title: ‘Resistance 3’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by Insomniac Games
cards.fact: Resistance 3 is a 2011 first-person shooter video game developed by Insomniac Games and published by Sony Computer Entertainment for the PlayStation 3.

cards.title: ‘Parasite’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by Bong Joon-ho
cards.fact: Parasite is a 2019 South Korean black comedy thriller film directed by Bong Joon Ho, who co-wrote the screenplay with Han Jin-won.

cards.title: Las Vegas Raiders is founded
cards.subtitle: NFL franchise
cards.fact: The Las Vegas Raiders are a professional American football team based in the Las Vegas metropolitan area.

cards.title: ‘Tron’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by Steven Lisberger
cards.fact: Tron is a 1982 American science fiction action adventure film written and directed by Steven Lisberger from a story he co-wrote with Bonnie MacBird.

cards.title: Los Angeles Lakers is founded
cards.subtitle: NBA franchise
cards.fact: The Los Angeles Lakers are an American professional basketball team based in Los Angeles.

cards.title: McDonnell Douglas F-15 Eagle first flies
cards.subtitle: Aircraft by McDonnell Douglas
cards.fact: The McDonnell Douglas F-15 Eagle is an American twin-engine, all-weather fighter aircraft designed by McDonnell Douglas.

cards.title: Ananda Mahidol becomes King of Thailand
cards.fact: Ananda Mahidol was the eighth king of Siam from the Chakri dynasty, titled Rama VIII.

cards.title: ‘Dune Messiah’ is published
cards.subtitle: Book by Frank Herbert
cards.fact: Dune Messiah is a 1969 science fiction novel by American writer Frank Herbert, the second in his Dune series of six novels.

cards.title: ‘Jak II’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by Naughty Dog
cards.fact: Jak II is a 2003 action-adventure platform video game developed by Naughty Dog and published by Sony Computer Entertainment for the PlayStation 2 (PS2).

cards.title: Grand Principality of Vladimir is established
cards.subtitle: Historical state
cards.fact: The Grand Principality of Vladimir, before 1157 the Principality of Suzdal, and commonly known as Vladimir-Suzdal, or simply Suzdalia and Vladimiria, was a medieval principality that was established during the disintegration of Kievan Rus'.

cards.title: Émile Loubet becomes president of France
cards.fact: Émile François Loubet was the 45th Prime Minister of France from February to December 1892 and later President of France from 1899 to 1906.

cards.title: ‘Nineteen Eighty-Four’ is published
cards.subtitle: Book by George Orwell
cards.fact: Nineteen Eighty-Four is a dystopian speculative fiction novel by the English writer George Orwell.

cards.title: ‘Kiss’ is released
cards.subtitle: Album by Kiss
cards.fact: Kiss is the debut studio album by American rock band Kiss, released on February 8, 1974, by Casablanca Records.

cards.title: Heath Ledger dies
cards.subtitle: Australian actor
cards.fact: Heath Andrew Ledger was an Australian actor.

cards.title: ‘Ruwiki’ launches
cards.subtitle: Website
cards.fact: Ruwiki is a Russian multilingual online encyclopedia, with editions in Russian and other languages of the Russian Federation.

cards.title: ‘The Umbrellas’ is painted
cards.subtitle: Painting by Pierre-Auguste Renoir
cards.fact: The Umbrellas is an oil-on-canvas painting by Pierre-Auguste Renoir, painted in two phases in the 1880s.
